basic_info.description: Ethereal - The Infinity San Francisco Abode - Step into this exquisite 1 Bedroom, 1 Bathroom home with an expansive den: where serenity and organic sophistication blend seamlessly. This rare find offers views "Feel the Vibe of the City Without Ever Leaving Home." Grand foyer opens to a spacious living area, framed by floor-to-ceiling windows, inviting natural light. New Oak floors throughout. Entertainer's dream kitchen: featuring custom rustic wood bar extension, premium Thermador refrigerator, Bosch gas cooktop & newer Miele dishwasher. With abundant counter space, it's the true heart of the home. Specialized water filtration system & new age touch kitchen faucet are next level. The generously sized primary suite is a tranquil retreat with a sitting area, floor-to-ceiling windows, and large walk-in closet. Enjoy a wellness bathroom with soaking tub and expansive vanity; creating an ideal sanctuary. The XXL den is more than just a place to work, think hobby/spirituality & extra guest space. A newer Miele washer & dryer speaks elegance. HOA fees cover majority of utilities, building staff, maintenance and access to world-class 5-star amenities. Secure deeded XL parking. Your private urban oasis awaits along the famed San Francisco Waterfront with world class entertainment venues.
